One Fine Day…

An amazing waltz played by Calum Stewart on his album with Heikki Bourgault. Quite complicated, though.

↳ Posted by andrewyakovenko on November 18th, 2013.

Thanks for sharing ruthruin!!

It’s a fantastic piece and it shows the great technique Calum has. After the first part in C he goes to Gflat major! You have a very tricky keywork there!
